steps.summary: On Grafana's 'fwgr31-n3 Bench Dashboard' I set the top-bar time picker to 'Last 6 hours', opened Dashboard settings (keyboard shortcut d then s, since the gear is not in this toolbar) > General, typed 'bench' + Enter into Tags (chip added), clicked Save dashboard, ticked the 'Update default time range' checkbox in the save drawer (it was unticked by default) and confirmed; the app showed "Dashboard saved". I then returned to the dashboard (no unsaved-changes indicator: Save dashboard/Exit edit buttons gone) and reloaded the clean dashboard URL /d/cfy6hdylxv85cc/fwgr31-n3-bench-dashboard with no query params — the top bar still read "Last 6 hours" and the tag chip 'bench' was still present in Dashboard settings > General, confirming both changes persisted. Values reported are those the live DOM/labels showed; the tag chip and 6h range were re-read after reload, while the checkbox ticked-at-save is what I observed in the drawer before saving.

steps.summary: On 'fwgr31-n3 Bench Dashboard' (URL /d/cfy6hdylxv85cc/fwgr31-n3-bench-dashboard) I selected '1m' in the top-bar refresh-interval control, which set the picker to 1m but did NOT mark the dashboard dirty (no Save dashboard button / dirty indicator appeared). So I persisted it via the save drawer instead: opening Save dashboard showed "No changes to save", but the drawer's checkbox 'Update default refresh value — Will make the current refresh the new default' was available; I ticked it (a "Changes 1" tab appeared and Save became enabled) and clicked Save, which returned "Dashboard saved". I then reloaded the bare dashboard URL with no query params; the top bar shows time range "Last 6 hours" and the refresh control reads 1m (aria-label "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected"), and the URL was rewritten to ?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m, confirming both are persisted. Note: no 'Update default time range' checkbox existed in this save drawer (only the refresh one); the 6-hour default was already persisted from the earlier save and verified to survive the reload.
